en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

en: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
u.src: 1  Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

p.src: 2  Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

ja: してください。 悪を行う者たちの騒がしい群れから。
en: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
u.src: 2  Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

p.src: 3  who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

ja: ぎ、 矢を、すなわち致命的な
en: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
u.src: 3  who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

p.src: 4  to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

ja: れることなくその人を射る。
en: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
u.src: 4  to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

p.src: 5  They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

ja: けようと語り合う。 「誰がそれを
en: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
u.src: 5  They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

p.src: 6  They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

ja: たちは完璧な計画を練り上げた」と。まことに、
en: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
u.src: 6  They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

p.src: 7  But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

ja: らは矢に打たれて、たちまち倒れる。
en: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
u.src: 7  But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

p.src: 8  Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

en: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
u.src: 8  Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

p.src: 9  All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

ja: らせ、 神がなされたことを賢く思い巡らす。
en: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
u.src: 9  All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

p.src: 10  The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
u.src: 10  The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
